_comment: Fixture for the Playwright specs frontend/e2e/015-create-portfolio.spec.ts (create) and
frontend/e2e/888-delete-portfolio.spec.ts (teardown).
Hand-authored — must NOT be moved into testdata/generated/, nv.bat wipes that directory.
'delete' is the teardown definition: a portfolio with delete=true is removed completely by 888
(all cash accounts, all securities accounts, then the portfolio itself). delete=false keeps the
portfolio in grafioschtrader_t after the suite has run — 888 then generates no test for it.
'loginNickname' refers to users.csv. 'e2euser' is registered through the UI by auth.setup.ts and
runs an English UI (en-US); 'alledit' is seeded by the backend ResoureTestSuite and runs a German
UI (de-CH) — therefore the specs match every menu text bilingually.
'transactions' are consumed by 090-bank-account-transactions.spec.ts. 'single' creates one
cash-account transaction; 'transfer' creates the connected withdrawal/deposit pair. Dates are
ISO calendar dates and the test supplies a deterministic noon time. Account names are resolved
inside their portfolio; a transfer names its destination portfolio explicitly. A standalone
foreign-currency transaction may carry valuationExchangeRate: the exact source-database close
is inserted only when the test database lacks a quote for that date.
'tradingPlatformPlan' is matched case-insensitively as a SUBSTRING of the option label in the
securities account dialog, because the label is language dependent. The plans come from
testdata/generated/tradingplatformplan.csv, but from two different producers: rows tagged e2e='i'
are seeded by the backend TradingPlatformPlanResourceTest — that covers 'CornèrTrader
Transaktionsbetrag' / 'CornèrTrader Transactions value' — while rows tagged e2e='e' are created
through the UI by frontend/e2e/012-create-trading-platform-plan.spec.ts, which covers 'Saxo
Trader' (DE = EN). That spec is numbered 012 so it runs before 015; renumbering it after 015
makes the SaxoTrader securities account fail with 'no trading platform plan matching Saxo Trader'.
The plan and the portfolio below are both spelled 'CornèrTrader' (Cornèr Bank AG).
null means: take the first non-empty option.
'tradingPeriods' are ADDED to the two rows the dialog pre-fills for a new securities account
(Equities/Direct investment and Equities/ETF), they do not replace them. A null categoryType is
the empty option of the asset class select and means 'all asset classes'. The enum names are the
option values and therefore language independent. dateFrom 2000-01-03 is the oldest trading day,
which the dialog also pre-fills.
